statement: For two planar full-dimensional supports, the resultant of f1,f2 and their toric Jacobian factors as the discriminant cycle Δ̃(f1,f2) times vertex coefficients c_v^mm(v) and common-edge resultants raised to μ(η). Its cycle bidegree is δ_i=Vol(Q_j)+2MV(Q1,Q2)−Σ_(η∈Σ′) length(e_j^η)μ(η)−Σ_(v vertex of Ai)mm(v), i≠j. Here mm(v)=MV(Q1,Q2)−MV(conv(Ai minus {v}),Qj), Σ′ consists of shared edge normals, and μ is the minimum inward lattice gap.

answer.text: Explicitly factors the toric-Jacobian resultant and derives both coefficient degrees of the plane mixed-discriminant cycle.
